notes: Multiple targeted searches (xd.is sub-page, kosningasaga, kaffid.is, dal.is, Facebook, op-ed search) found no 2026 stefnuskrá or áherslur document for the Dalvíkurbyggð D-list. xd.is/sveitastjornir/dalvikurbyggd returned 404. Only candidate-list announcements exist for 2026 — no platform document or local party sub-site found. National xd.is platform is generic, not muni-specific.

Searches across xs.is, trolli.is, kosningasaga, kjarninn, Facebook all return only candidate-list announcements. The Trölli.is and kosningasaga pages describe the list/leader but do not link to a 2026 platform document. No dedicated party sub-site, no Facebook page found in search; xs.is has no Fjallabyggð-specific page.

The national party page xd.is/sveitastjornir/grundarfjordur/ has a muni-specific section listing current representatives (Jósef Ó. Kjartansson and others), 2022 election results, and a link to the slate's Facebook page. No standalone stefnuskrá document found; no dedicated sub-site (xdgrundarfjordur.is etc.) exists. Page mentions a Facebook link for the slate but the URL was not extractable from search snippets.

A-listi 'Öll saman' is a NEW slate combining former H-list and G-list members from 2022. Searches across feykir.is, huni.is, hunabyggd.is, kosningasaga return only the candidate roster announcement (March 2026) and an op-ed by Jón Gíslason on feykir.is from prior reporting. No 2026 stefnuskrá, no dedicated website, no Facebook page found. The askorandapenni feykir column is a personal piece, not a platform.

vik.is page lists both 2026 lists (A-Allra and Z-Samfélagsins) with candidates and occupations but no platform links. kosningasaga and aldurerbaratala interview cover candidate background only. No stefnuskrá document, dedicated website, or Facebook page found through search. Note: Björn Þór Ólafsson previously led B-list (Framsókn) in 2022.

The national xd.is sub-page for Skaftárhreppur lists current representatives (Sveinn Hreiðar Jensson and Jón Hrafn Karlsson), 2022 results (24.12%, 1 seat), and references a Facebook page for the local campaign. No standalone 2026 stefnuskrá or sub-site found. sunnlenska article (in existing data) only confirms two slates filed.

Three lists confirmed in Svalbarðsstrandarhreppur 2026: Samstaða (S), Strönd til framtíðar (H), Ströndungur (Ö). Searches across svalbardsstrond.is, kaffid.is, kosningasaga, Facebook return only candidate roster (10 names from Ólafur Rúnar Ólafsson through Waldemar Sienda). No platform document, no dedicated website, no Facebook page surfaced through search. This is a brand-new list (March 2026) so an online presence may not yet exist.

mbl.is interview/article 'Skuldsett en öflugt sveitarfélag' (April 23, 2026) covers H-list priorities directly: continued responsible financial management while preparing for growth, debt-ratio progress, kindergarten/school expansion, fisheries quota concerns. Skessuhorn (Apr 8) and RÚV (Apr 8) cover the launch but with less policy detail. No stefnuskrá PDF or dedicated website found. Note: H-list mayoral candidate is Jakob Björgvin Sigríðarson Jakobsson (current mayor 8 yrs).

Víkurfréttir (vf.is) news piece 'Nýr valkostur í Vogum' presents the A-list's stated priorities: 'sterkt og samheldið samfélag þar sem velferð íbúa, gagnsæ stjórnsýsla og ábyrg uppbygging eru í forgrunni' and 'aukið samráð við íbúa'. Lists all 14 candidates. This is the closest thing to a published platform — short on specifics but counts as best available source. No standalone stefnuskrá document or party website found; no Facebook page surfaced. Note: NOT to be confused with L-listinn í Vogum (different slate at l-listinn.is).

husavik.com article describes L-listi framfara as a 'civic list emphasizing job creation and population growth, particularly for families with children' — short summary of platform direction, lists all 14 candidates and occupations. RÚV (Mar 13) covers list determination. thingeyjarsveit.is and kaffid.is have only roster announcements. No standalone stefnuskrá document, dedicated website, or Facebook page found.
